Confidence intervals for a two-part model

Source: R/methods-extra.R
confint.twopart.Rd

Wald intervals for the coefficients of both parts of a twopart() fit, named as in coef() ("binary:...", "positive:..."), from vcov() (block diagonal for independent parts, the joint covariance for correlated = TRUE).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'twopart'
confint(object, parm, level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

object

a "twopart" fit

parm

names or positions of the coefficients; all by default

level

confidence level

...

unused

Value

a two-column matrix

See also

Other twopart methods: predict.twopart()

Examples

data(copd)
copd$cost <- ifelse(copd$exacerbations > 0, exp(6 + 0.1 * copd$crp), 0)
fit <- twopart(cost ~ treatment + crp, data = copd, index = c("id", "visit"))
#> Warning: NaNs produced
confint(fit)
#>                              2.5 %       97.5 %
#> binary:(Intercept)    3.470918e-01 1.350479e+00
#> binary:treatment     -4.799854e-01 1.997329e-01
#> binary:crp           -7.260436e-02 8.511146e-02
#> positive:(Intercept)  6.000000e+00 6.000000e+00
#> positive:treatment    8.425852e-14 1.294359e-13
#> positive:crp          1.000000e-01 1.000000e-01
